name: Cable High Reverse Fly
steps: Stand centered between two high pulleys and grip the opposite handles so your arms cross in front of you.
Step back slightly to create tension with your chest tall and a soft bend in both elbows.
Sweep your hands outward and slightly down until your arms align with your shoulders.
Squeeze your upper back briefly, then guide your hands forward and up under control.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your elbows without changing it.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning backward to finish the sweep.
